clauses.quote: The Salary Credit Review Committee shall review unusual circumstances not covered by the provisions contained in this article.
Unit members may make application for review with rationale to the Committee through the Office of Human Resources.
The Committee's written recommendation and rationale shall be forwarded to the Superintendent's Cabinet via the Associate Superintendent, Human Resources, with a copy sent to the unit member.
clauses.subject_text: The Committee's written recommendation and rationale

clauses.quote: The written decision of the Cabinet shall be sent to the unit member and to the chairperson of the Committee.
clauses.subject_text: The written decision of the Cabinet

clauses.quote: School Year 2003-2004 teachers’ and psychologists’ salary schedules shall be decreased .5% (one half percent) from the 2002-2003 salary schedule reflecting a school year of 186 work days (180 instructional days, 3 duty days, 3 staff development days).
clauses.subject_text: School Year 2003-2004 teachers’ and psychologists’ salary schedules

clauses.quote: Work days for non-186 day unit members’ calendars shall be decreased by one day from 2002-2003.
clauses.subject_text: Work days for non-186 day unit members’ calendars

clauses.quote: For school year 2004-2005 teachers' and psychologists' salary schedules shall be decreased 3.5% (three and one half percent) from the 2003-2004 salary schedule reflecting a school year of 185 work days (180 instructional days, 2 duty days, 3 staff development days).
Work years for all unit members shall be reduced by two days from the 2002-2003 calendar.
clauses.subject_text: Work years for all unit members

clauses.quote: For school year 2005-2006 the teachers' and psychologists' salary schedules and length of work year calendar shall remain the same as during 2004-2005 (180 instructional days, 2 duty days, 3 staff development days).
clauses.subject_text: the teachers' and psychologists' salary schedules and length of work year calendar
